prompt: Is "How tall am I?" a **statistical question**? (yes/no)
hint: A statistical question is one whose answers you would expect to vary from one case to another.

hints.text: A statistical question is one whose answers you would expect to vary from one case to another.
"How tall am I?" asks about one person at one moment. Think about how many different answers a measurement of one person can give.
The answer is no, because one person has one height and nothing varies.

explanation: A statistical question anticipates variability, meaning the data collected to answer it will differ.
"How tall am I?" is about a single person, and measuring that person gives a single height.
With only one answer there is no variability, so no, it is not a statistical question.
